views.system_context: Invoke authors one machine source; the canonical compiler validates and projects it; WPRA audits it twice; generated human views remain non-authoritative; Task Session is a later consumer only.
views.runtime: validate source -> stage projections -> WPRA run 1 -> WPRA run 2 -> compare -> atomically publish or erase stage
views.data: machine source and exact evidence refs are inputs; WPRA config, reports, receipt, and Markdown are deterministic projections
views.deployment: repository-local Python and JSON only; no service, network, package root, publication, or deployment

invariants: human views never become authority sources
staged outputs are invisible until terminal two-run PASS
future post-produce outputs and validators may be absent
every effect and write remains repository-local and reversible
selected_architecture: single-source deterministic projection with transactional publication

alternatives_rejected.reason: requires model interpretation at consumer boundaries
does not exercise installed canonical consumers
